tenderSchedule.description: Animal Birth Control of Stray Dogs IN TMC Channarayapatna

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All condition applicable as per Bid document
Annual Turnover Certificate in last five years 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
Bidder should have achieved a minimum of Rs.10.00 Lakhs turnover in any two of the last recent five Financial Year
Details of number of proposed dog-catching vehicles, dog catchers, operation theaters, veterinary doctors, other staff, other equipment and facilities available
Previous experience with similar works executed for any of the Urban local bodies/Govt Department for at least three years
Registration Certificate with the Animal Welfare Board of India
Similar work done certificate in any one year of the last three years -2023-24 2024-25 2025-26 from Govt department for 5.00 lakhs
The firm should have a Own Vehicle registration certificate and Experienced hands for catching the dogs and Qualified Veterinary Surgeons degree certificate
